about: Board Race tasks per level. kind 'forms': items with matching answers (shown on Reveal). kind 'list': write as many as you can; examples shown on Reveal. M.1 verb forms and basic vocabulary, M.2 holiday words and past continuous, M.3 idioms and collocations. Written for Kru.
